Why the C-3 is the form that matters

The C-3 — Employee Claim is what actually opens your case with the New York Workers' Compensation Board. Until it's filed, the Board has no record of your claim. In most cases you have two years from the date of injury (or from when you knew the injury was work-related) to file — and incomplete or inconsistent answers can slow your claim down or invite a dispute.

The Claim Filing Wizard walks you through every section in plain English, explains what each question is really asking, and helps you file it right the first time.
